Within-Groups (Repeated Measures) ANOVA

wg_anova_answers.Rd

Performs a one-way repeated measures ANOVA comparing two conditions measured on the same participants.

Usage

wg_anova_answers(data, dv1, dv2, id_var = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble in wide format.

dv1

Character string. Name of the first condition's variable.

dv2

Character string. Name of the second condition's variable.

id_var

Character string or NULL. Name of the subject ID variable. If NULL, row numbers are used as subject IDs.

Value

A list with elements:

ANOVA

A list with F, p_value, df_effect, df_error, mse, and method.

Descriptives

A tibble with condition, mean, sd, n, and sem.

Sample_Size

Number of unique participants.

Examples

data(superman)
result <- wg_anova_answers(superman,
  dv1 = "rt_critics_score",
  dv2 = "rt_audience_score"
)
#> Warning: Error() model is singular
result$ANOVA
#> $F
#> [1] 0.09
#> 
#> $p_value
#> [1] 0.771
#> 
#> $df_effect
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $df_error
#> [1] 7
#> 
#> $mse
#> [1] 43.86
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] "Repeated Measures ANOVA"
#> 
result$Descriptives
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   condition          mean    sd     n   sem
#>   <fct>             <dbl> <dbl> <int> <dbl>
#> 1 rt_audience_score  80.2  9.86     9  3.29
#> 2 rt_critics_score   79.4 10.5      8  3.72
